title: Selections from the Writings of the Báb
textType: Authoritative text revealed by the Báb
author: the-bab
attributionNote: Selections from the Writings of the Báb, by the Báb: the Bahá’í Reference Library's own record of the work, on its The Báb shelf.
description: A collection of excerpts from books and Tablets revealed by the Báb, including the Qayyúmu’l-Asmá’ (Commentary on the Súrih of Joseph), the Persian Bayán, Dalá’il-i-Sab‘ih (the Seven Proofs), the Kitáb-i-Asmá’ (the Book of Names), and various other Writings. It was first published in an authorized English translation in 1976. The record was created by the Bahá’í import from the Reference Library's own catalogue and reading views; the summary above is the library's own description of the work, and an editor's note for the work itself is still to be written.
historicalContext: Read in the Bahá’í Reference Library, in the section where the Bahá’í International Community publishes the authorised English text (The Báb).
availabilityNote: Complete as the Reference Library publishes it: the library's reading views for this work are streamed from bahai.org at read time, one chapter at a time, with the Community's copyright notice. The chapters are the divisions of the library's own reading text; the publication's front matter and its notes are not imported.
